proposals.before: Empress Dowager Huayang, the queen of King Xiaowen, was to be interred with King Xiaowen at the Shouling tomb.
proposals.after: Empress Dowager Huayang, the queen of King Xiaowen, was buried with King Xiaowen at the Shouling tomb.
proposals.reason: Chinese 會葬 states the burial as a completed arrangement, not a prospective plan; 'was to be interred' wrongly implies futurity.

proposals.before: The queen of King Xiaowen, called Empress Dowager Huayang, was to be buried with King Xiaowen at the Shouling tomb.
proposals.after: The queen of King Xiaowen, called Empress Dowager Huayang, was buried with King Xiaowen at the Shouling tomb.
proposals.reason: Same futurity error as the idiomatic rendering of 會葬.

decisions.reason: 會葬 records the completed joint burial of Empress Dowager Huayang with King Xiaowen at Shouling; the following contrast with Empress Dowager Xia’s separate burial (獨別葬) confirms this as narrative fact, so “was to be interred” wrongly adds futurity and “was buried” is accurate.

The same 會葬 is a completed joint-burial statement, not a prospective plan; replacing “was to be buried” with “was buried” removes the false futurity while preserving the rest of the literal rendering.
